photographs.name: DSC07520
photographs.title: 潮汐的形状
photographs.description: 澳大利亚海岸，浅色沙洲与蓝绿色海水交织。
photographs.descriptionEn: Pale sandbars meet turquoise water along the Australian coast.
photographs.note: 沙洲的浅色曲线把水面分成几种深浅。远处的山与近处的潮水叠在一起，辽阔的空间有了细小而缓慢的变化。
photographs.noteEn: Pale curves of sand divide the water into shades of depth. Distant hills meet the nearer tide, giving an expansive space a small, slow movement.

photographs.name: DSC02777
photographs.title: 街巷之间
photographs.description: 京都街巷中的屋顶、行人与远山。
photographs.descriptionEn: Rooftops, passersby and distant hills in Kyoto.
photographs.note: 屋顶层层向远山延伸，行人被留在街道的窄处。建筑与山的轮廓连在一起，目光沿着人群走入画面。
photographs.noteEn: Roofs extend towards the distant hills; people occupy the narrow street below. The outlines of buildings and mountains join, drawing the eye into the picture along the crowd.

photographs.name: DSC07749
photographs.title: 蓝色的纹理
photographs.description: 从高处俯瞰海水与礁石的纹理。
photographs.descriptionEn: Patterns of water and reef seen from above.
photographs.note: 礁石的纹理隔着海水显露出来。俯瞰让距离变得难以判断：海的深度，暂时成为一片颜色与线条。
photographs.noteEn: The reef shows through the water. From above, distance becomes difficult to judge: the depth of the sea briefly takes the form of colour and line.

photographs.name: DSC09617
photographs.title: 城市的缝隙
photographs.description: 香港街巷中，高楼之间的行人与道路。
photographs.descriptionEn: A street, pedestrians and tall buildings in Hong Kong.
photographs.note: 街道被高楼夹成一道细缝，人的身形因而显得很小。视线顺着建筑向下，最终落在仍然有人走过的路上。
photographs.noteEn: Tall buildings narrow the street to a seam and make the figures seem small. The eye follows the architecture down to a road where people continue to pass.

photographs.name: DSC04302
photographs.title: 渡船上的片刻
photographs.description: 曼谷渡船上，一位乘客望向河岸。
photographs.descriptionEn: A passenger looks towards the riverbank from a ferry in Bangkok.
photographs.note: 座椅、窗框与乘客的侧影，把流动的河岸围进一个安静的片刻。船在移动，画面却把目光留在了她身旁。
photographs.noteEn: Seats, a window frame and a passenger’s profile enclose the moving riverbank in a quiet moment. The boat is travelling, but the picture keeps our gaze beside her.

photographs.name: IMG_20240518_223126
photographs.title: 光里的身影
photographs.description: 室内展览空间中，三个人的剪影。
photographs.descriptionEn: Three silhouettes inside an exhibition space.
photographs.note: 亮处与暗处在墙面上分开，三个人的身影成为这道边界的尺度。人物之间的空隙，也像空间的一部分。
photographs.noteEn: Light and shade divide the wall; three figures give that boundary a human scale. The gaps between them become part of the space.

photographs.name: DSC00886
photographs.title: 林间的光
photographs.description: 南京林间，阳光穿过树木落在草地上。
photographs.descriptionEn: Sunlight falls through the trees onto grass in Nanjing.
photographs.note: 树影把草地分成明亮与幽暗的部分。细密的枝干在画面里重复，光从它们之间落下来。
photographs.noteEn: Shadows divide the grass into bright and dark areas. Slender branches repeat across the frame, with light falling between them.

photographs.name: DSC00272_1
photographs.title: 灶台前
photographs.description: 越南街头，一位厨师在灶台前烹饪。
photographs.descriptionEn: A cook at work beside a street-side stove in Vietnam.
photographs.note: 灶台与锅占据了前景，人的动作在器具之间展开。颜色、手势与狭窄的工作空间，构成这一刻的秩序。
photographs.noteEn: The stove and pan occupy the foreground, with a gesture unfolding among the utensils. Colour, movement and a narrow working space give this moment its order.

photographs.name: IMG_20240430_085311
photographs.title: 经过海面
photographs.description: 蓝绿色海面上，船只留下弧形的白色航迹。
photographs.descriptionEn: A boat leaves a curved white wake across turquoise water.
photographs.note: 船很小，身后的白色线条却向远处展开。水面保存了它刚刚经过的方向，航迹也成为画面里的时间刻度。
photographs.noteEn: The boat is small, but the white line behind it extends into the distance. The water holds the direction of its passage; the wake becomes a measure of time within the frame.

photographs.name: IMG_20240213_210927
photographs.title: 一束光
photographs.description: 澳门室内空间中的十字架、石块与天光。
photographs.descriptionEn: A cross, stone and daylight inside a space in Macau.
photographs.note: 天光沿墙面落下，十字架与石块留在暖色的暗处。简单的形状因明暗的分界而有了重量与距离。
photographs.noteEn: Daylight falls along the wall, while a cross and stones remain in warm shadow. A boundary between light and dark gives these simple forms weight and distance.

photographs.name: DSC09079
photographs.title: 朱红的秩序
photographs.description: 大阪，朱红色鸟居框出的神社入口。
photographs.descriptionEn: A vermilion torii frames a shrine entrance in Osaka.
photographs.note: 重复的朱红门框把视线推向庭院。进入与停留之间，只隔着一道明亮的边界。
photographs.noteEn: Repeating vermilion gates lead the eye towards the courtyard. A bright boundary separates entering from pausing.

photographs.name: IMG_20250308_232434
photographs.title: 雨落东京
photographs.description: 雨夜东京街头，灯光映照湿润的路面。
photographs.descriptionEn: Street lights reflect on the wet pavement in Tokyo at night.
photographs.note: 雨水让路面成为另一幅城市图像。灯牌与人的身影在上下两层空间里相遇，倒影很快又被脚步打断。
photographs.noteEn: Rain makes the road into another image of the city. Signs and figures meet above and below, their reflections interrupted by passing feet.

photographs.name: IMG_20250203_161907
photographs.title: 水边的静处
photographs.description: 厦门水面上的亭子与倒影。
photographs.descriptionEn: A pavilion and its reflection on the water in Xiamen.
photographs.note: 亭子与倒影在水面上下相接。岸边的树木围住这一小块空间，使目光暂时从远处回到水边。
photographs.noteEn: The pavilion meets its reflection across the water. Trees enclose this small space, bringing the eye back from a distance to the water’s edge.

photographs.name: DSC01813
photographs.title: 灰蓝的海
photographs.description: 济州岛海岸，岩石与海鸟。
photographs.descriptionEn: Rocks and seabirds along the coast of Jeju.
photographs.note: 浅水、石块与一只白色水鸟，把海岸的边缘分成细小的层次。海面没有明确的终点，近处却有一个安静的落脚处。
photographs.noteEn: Shallow water, stones and a white shorebird give the edge of the coast its small layers. The sea has no clear endpoint, while the foreground offers a quiet place to rest the eye.
